Smart Lock and Electronic Key

Scope a 4S access-control solution for locked barriers, covers and doors at hazardous areas on construction sites.

Discuss your project↘

4S requirements to specify

Authorised keys and register

Specify electronic keys with the holder’s identity and permission for designated locks. Keep a register of issued keys and review permissions as site roles change.

Local warning

For forced entry or an expired key, specify the contract’s local warning. The sample provision cites a siren of at least 70 dB or a higher agreed level, and/or a flashing red light.

Notifications and event records

Scope SMS or in-app alerts for relevant site staff and event recording in the designated platform. The sample calls for the lock location, incident time and electronic key ID in the alert.

Access points covered by the sample specification

Electrical
Electrical distribution board cabinets
Floor openings
Openings of 500 × 500 mm or larger in the sample provision
Restricted entrances
Confined-space entrances and lift shaft openings
DEVB TC(W) No. 3/2023, updated Annex A, clause 5(12)(d)↗
